openai.pokyny: Voice acting for a comedy point-and-click adventure game. Speak {jazyk} with native pronunciation, natural pacing and comic timing. Do not read stage directions. Character: {postava} Delivery: {emoce}.

elevenlabs.poznamka: Standardní hlasy ElevenLabs: Ruda Eric, Bára Alice, Pembok Bill, Pan Změna Callum, Předseda George, Rozhlas Daniel. Ostatní doplnit po výběru z knihovny (--hlasy --sluzba elevenlabs, klíč potřebuje oprávnění voices_read).

Ruda.popis: Rudy Gantt, overconfident project manager in his forties, talks fast, everything is a 'phase'.

Bára.popis: Barb Backlog, calm practical engineer, dry and matter-of-fact, the voice of reason.

Pembok.popis: Prof. Pembok, elderly professor and narrator-mentor, dry wit, slow and precise.

Pan Změna.popis: Mr. Change, hidden voice behind a market stall, giddy, changes his mind mid-sentence.

Předseda.popis: Chairman Evermore, elderly bureaucrat, kind, slow and unhurried, never says no, only 'next phase'.

Framework.popis: Dr. Framework, methodology consultant, smooth and smug, loves jargon.

Starosta.popis: The mayor, loud populist, promises everything to everyone.

Babička.popis: Granny Plotkins, sweet old lady with a sharp edge.

Druhý věřitel.popis: A second creditor, even more impatient.

Rozhlas.popis: Town public-address announcer, flat official tone with a crackle of boredom.

Pepa.popis: Two-Day Joe, cheerful handyman, everything takes 'two days'.

Věra.popis: Vera Rebar, tough welder, few words.

Norbert.popis: Norman Standards, pedantic inspector, nasal and precise.

Zdenda.popis: Benny Buddy, mayor's buddy, lazy and friendly.

Kryštof.popis: Chip Checkbox, nervous tester, speaks in checklists.
